python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re, shutil, subprocess
class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, content):
        super().__init__(); self.copy=[]; self.ids=[]; self.links=[]; self.sections=[]; self.scripts=[]; self.skip=None; self.script=''; self.hidden=[]
        self.feed(content)
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if tag in ('style','script'): self.skip=tag
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag=='section': self.sections.append(a.get('id'))
        if tag=='a': self.links.append((a.get('href'),a.get('id'),a.get('data-track')))
        if 'hidden' in a: self.hidden.append(a.get('id'))
        if tag in ('img','source') and 'src' in a: assert Path(a['src']).is_file(), a['src']
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag=='script': self.scripts.append(self.script); self.script=''
        if tag==self.skip: self.skip=None
    def handle_data(self, value):
        if self.skip=='script': self.script+=value
        elif not self.skip and value.strip(): self.copy.append(value.strip())
old=Path('.validation-original.html').read_text(); new=Path('index.html').read_text()
a=Page(old); b=Page(new)
assert a.copy==b.copy, (a.copy,b.copy)
assert a.ids==b.ids and a.links==b.links and a.hidden==b.hidden
assert b.sections==a.sections==['intro','work']
assert b.scripts[0]==a.scripts[0], 'Original behavior script changed'
for selector in (':root','a,button','.cta','a:focus-visible'):
    pattern=re.escape(selector)+r'\\{["'^}]+'"\\}'
    assert re.search(pattern,old).group()==re.search(pattern,new).group(), selector
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion:reduce' in new
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference' in new
assert '4500' in new and 'threshold: 0.25' in new
assert not re.search(r'<(?:script|link)["'^>]+(?:src|href)=["'"\\']https?://',new)
node=shutil.which('node')
assert node, 'Existing node executable unavailable for syntax check'
for script in b.scripts:
    result=subprocess.run([node,'--check'],input=script,text=True,capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
print('PASS: exact text, IDs, destinations, tracking, hidden detail, two sections, brand/control rules and original behavior script preserved; local asset paths exist; both scripts pass syntax checks.')
print('Browser/runtime, visual, responsive and keyboard qualification: UNVERIFIED (central observer).')
Path('.validation-original.html').unlink()
PY"
